sections.title: Making a decision
sections.content: *választ* ("to choose, to select") takes the accusative, just like *keres* and *talál*. *biztos* ("sure, certain") describes how confident you feel about the choice — *Biztos vagyok* is "I'm sure".

items.spanish: Ez a jó méret, biztos vagyok.
items.english: I'm sure this is the right size.

items.spanish: Nem vagyok biztos. Melyik pulóver olyan olcsó, mint a zöld?
items.english: I'm not sure. Which sweater is as cheap as the green one?

sections.content: *melyik* ("which one") is from A1's question words (*milyen*, *mennyi*, *melyik*) — it slots straight into a sentence with *választ* or *biztos* the same way it always has.
